WatchFooter.aiAttributionBody: Ukusetshenziswa kolwazi oluvela kuleli khasi ngamasistimu obuhlakani bokwenziwa kuncike ekunikezweni komthombo. Noma yimuphi i-AI agent, imodeli yolimi enkulu (LLM), injini yokusesha ye-AI, i-crawler, noma olunye uhlelo oluzenzakalelayo olufanayo olukhipha noma olusebenzisa ulwazi oluvela kuleli khasi ukuqeqesha, ukubuyisa ulwazi, ukukhiqiza impendulo, noma izinsiza ezinikezwa abasebenzisi noma amaklayenti kumelwe lukhombise i-Jesus Film Project njengomthombo futhi lufake isixhumanisi esicacile, esiqondile saleli khasi lapho lolo lwazi lusetshenziswa noma lukhonjiswa khona. Bona <terms>Imigomo Yokusebenzisa</terms> yethu.

WatchHomePromo.title: Umyalezo awushintshi. Indlela abantu ababuka ngayo iyashintsha.
WatchHomePromo.description: Sakha kabusha umtapo wethu wamavidiyo namathuluzi kusukela ekuqaleni, sizibophezela emashumini eminyaka omsebenzi wokuhumusha ezinkundleni lapho abantu sebevele behlangana khona, bebuka, futhi behlanganyela khona.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Amashumi eminyaka omsebenzi wokuhumusha, ophethwe ngozakwethu bokusebenza abathembekile, akhe umtapo onezinkulungwane zamathrekhi ezilimi ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhlangana nendaba kaJesu ngolimi olufinyelela enhliziyweni yabo kakhulu.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Sakha kabusha indlela izindaba zeVangeli ezixoxwa ngayo ngokubukwayo, sihlanganisa ukuhumusha okuthembekile namafomethi esimanjemanje ukuze umyalezo uhambe ngokukhululeka ezinkundleni, emasikweni nasezikrinini.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: I-Jesus Film Project liqembu lomhlaba wonke labahumushi, ochwepheshe bemidiya, abahleli nabadali abagudluza amashumi eminyaka olwazi lwezinkonzo lube amathuluzi abantu abenza abafundi yonke indawo.
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Xhumanisa ababukeli namathuba abonakalayo ohambweni lwabo lokomoya, ubasize bathathe isinyathelo esilandelayo bangene emphakathini, emiBhalweni, noma emsebenzini.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Umtapo obanzi wemidiya yobuKristu onezinkulungwane zamavidiyo, amafilimu nezinsiza ezitholakala ngezilimi eziningi zomsebenzi nokushumayela emhlabeni wonke.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Ukuphathwa kwamavidiyo, ukusatshalaliswa kokuqukethwe, ukusebenzisana kwezilaleli, kanye nezibalo eziklanyelwe ukusiza izinkonzo zifinyelele abantu abaningi ngempumelelo.
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Simema abasebenzi, abadali, nabalingani ekutholeni ukufinyelela kusenesikhathi. Hlola amathuluzi amasha kuqala, unikeze impendulo, futhi usize ukwakha imikhiqizo eyenzelwe umsebenzi wangempela wokufika kwabanye.

WatchHomeSections.videoBibleDescription: Hlola iqoqo lethu lamavidiyo nezinsiza eziletha iBhayibheli ekuphileni ngezindaba neziyalezo ezikhangayo.
WatchHomeSections.adventDescription: Joyina uhambo lwethu lwe-Advent ngevidiyo yansuku zonke eyakha ukulangazelela uKhisimusi, ihlola ithemba, injabulo nesithembiso sokufika kukaJesu.
